```{r} 
source(
  here::here(
    "3-scripts",
    "0-setup.r"
  )
)

model_dir <- here::here("2-data", "models")
figure_dir <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sal_clean <- sal

wq_ipdw_inputs <- list(
  salinity = list(data = sal, unit = "ppt"),
  dissolved_oxygen = list(data = do, unit = "mg/L"),
  chlorophyll_a = list(data = chla, unit = "ug/L"),
  turbidity = list(data = turb, unit = "NTU"),
  water_temperature = list(data = temp, unit = "degrees C")
)

dist_pwr <- c(
  0.25,
  0.5,
  0.75,
  1,
  1.25,
  1.5,
  2,
  2.5,
  3
)

max_rng <- c(
  5000, 
  10000,  
  15000,
  20000
)

force_tuning <- FALSE
validation_seeds <- 1:5
block_size <- 5000
k_folds <- 5

if (any(vapply(wq_ipdw_inputs, function(x) is.null(x$data), logical(1)))) {
  stop("Run 3-environmental-data.qmd before fitting the IPDW models.")
}

```

# Salinity

Test model sensitivity against distance power X max range interactions
```{r}
# SAL
sensitivity_path <- file.path(
  model_dir,
  "salinity_sensitivity_100m.rds"
)

sensitivity_signature <- ipdw_sensitivity_signature(
  sal_clean,
  value_col = "mean",
  dist_powers = dist_pwr,
  max_ranges = max_rng,
  seed_values = validation_seeds,
  block_size = block_size,
  k = k_folds
)

cached_sensitivity <- if (file.exists(sensitivity_path)) {
  readRDS(sensitivity_path)
} else {
  NULL
}

cache_is_current <- !is.null(cached_sensitivity) &&
  identical(cached_sensitivity$cache_signature, sensitivity_signature)

if (cache_is_current && !force_tuning) {
  sal_sensitivity <- cached_sensitivity
} else {
  sal_sensitivity <- ipdw_sensitivity(
    sal_clean,
    cost_raster,
    n_seeds = 5,
    seed_values = validation_seeds,
    value_col = "mean",
    unit = "ppt",
    dist_powers = dist_pwr,
    max_ranges = max_rng,
    block_size = block_size,
    k = k_folds
  )
  sal_sensitivity$cache_signature <- sensitivity_signature

  saveRDS(sal_sensitivity, sensitivity_path)
  saveRDS(
    sal_sensitivity,
    file.path(model_dir, "salinity_sensitivity_test.rds")
  )
}

selected_parameters <- sal_sensitivity$selected
tested_parameters <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  dist_power = dist_pwr,
  max_range = max_rng
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(dplyr::inner_join(
    selected_parameters[c("dist_power", "max_range")],
    tested_parameters,
    by = c("dist_power", "max_range")
  )) == 1
)

sal_prediction_rows <- sal_sensitivity$point_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dist_power == selected_parameters$dist_power,
    max_range == selected_parameters$max_range
  )

prediction_counts <- sal_prediction_rows %>%
  dplyr::count(cell_id, name = "n_predictions")

stopifnot(
  nrow(prediction_counts) == nrow(sal_clean),
  all(prediction_counts$n_predictions == 5)
)

sal_validation <- list(
  point_results = sal_prediction_rows,
  fold_results = summarise_ipdw_metrics(
    sal_prediction_rows,
    c("seed", "fold", "dist_power", "max_range")
  ),
  seed_results = summarise_ipdw_metrics(
    sal_prediction_rows,
    c("seed", "dist_power", "max_range")
  ),
  summary = selected_parameters
)

direct_metrics <- summarise_ipdw_metrics(
  sal_prediction_rows,
  c("seed", "dist_power", "max_range")
)
saved_metrics <- sal_sensitivity$raw_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dist_power == selected_parameters$dist_power,
    max_range == selected_parameters$max_range
  )

stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(direct_metrics, saved_metrics)))

saveRDS(
  selected_parameters,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_selected_parameters_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_validation,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_validation_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_prediction_rows,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_prediction_rows_100m.rds")
)

utils::write.csv(
  selected_parameters,
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_selected_parameters_100m.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.csv(
  sal_validation$seed_results,
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_metrics_by_seed_100m.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.csv(
  sal_validation$fold_results,
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_metrics_by_fold_100m.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

 run model using tuned parameters

```{r}
sal_paths <- ipdw::pathdistGen(
  sf_ob = sal_clean,
  costras = cost_raster,
  range = selected_parameters$max_range,
  progressbar = FALSE
)

sal_bundle <- ipdw_manual(
  sal_clean,
  cost_raster,
  selected_parameters$max_range,
  "mean",
  dist_power = selected_parameters$dist_power,
  path_dists = sal_paths,
  return_support = TRUE,
  progressbar = FALSE
)

sal_qa <- ipdw_qa(
  sal_bundle,
  cost_raster,
  sal_clean,
  max_range = selected_parameters$max_range,
  value_col = "mean"
)

sal_moran <- ipdw_moran(
  sal_prediction_rows,
  sal_clean,
  sal_paths,
  nsim = 999
)

sal_diagnostics <- ipdw_diagnostics(
  sal_prediction_rows,
  sal_clean,
  sensitivity_summary = sal_sensitivity$summary,
  unit = "ppt"
)

saveRDS(
  sal_bundle$surface,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_ipdw_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_bundle$surface,
  file.path(model_dir, "sal_ipdw.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_bundle$contributor_count,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_contributor_count_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_bundle$nearest_path_distance,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_nearest_path_distance_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_bundle,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_ipdw_bundle_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_diagnostics,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_ipdw_diagnostics_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_qa,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_ipdw_qa_100m.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  sal_moran,
  file.path(model_dir, "salinity_moran_by_seed_100m.rds")
)

utils::write.csv(
  sal_sensitivity$summary,
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_sensitivity_summary_100m.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.csv(
  sal_prediction_rows,
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_prediction_rows_100m.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.csv(
  sal_moran,
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_moran_by_seed_100m.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.csv(
  sal_qa,
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_ipdw_qa_100m.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_observed_predicted_100m.png"),
  sal_diagnostics$observed_vs_predicted,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_prediction_error_100m.png"),
  sal_diagnostics$prediction_error,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_error_distribution_100m.png"),
  sal_diagnostics$error_distribution,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_spatial_error_100m.png"),
  sal_diagnostics$spatial_error,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_support_error_100m.png"),
  sal_diagnostics$support_error,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "salinity_parameter_sensitivity_100m.png"),
  sal_diagnostics$parameter_sensitivity,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

plot(sal_bundle$surface)
sal_validation$seed_results
sal_validation$fold_results
sal_moran
sal_qa
```
